excluded.startGuestSession: Creates a throwaway guest workspace; agents always act as the signed-in person.
excluded.logoutUser: Would end the agent's own session. Disconnect an agent under Account → Security → Active sessions, or use revoke_account_session.
excluded.openMediaRealtimeToken: Returns a live Open Media credential for the web app's realtime socket; agents never hold credentials.
excluded.saveOpenaiApiKey: Secret keys never go through chat. Add your OpenAI key in Account → AI settings.
excluded.connectIntegration: Takes raw OAuth tokens. Connect integrations from Account → Integrations in the app, where the provider's sign-in runs.
excluded.runBackgroundTasks: Superseded by enqueue_background_tasks, which is durable and deduplicated.
excluded.rest:upload-profile-picture: Needs a file upload (multipart). Change your picture in Account → Profile.
